data.name: Shishpal
data.gender_notes: Shishpal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who holds the universe in his hands, Shishpal is a name that signifies immense power and control over all aspects of life. Derived from Sanskrit words shishi, meaning 'lord', and pal, meaning 'of the universe', this name is a reminder of the immense potential within each of us to shape our reality. The name Shishpal carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shishpal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking to embody the divine as the ruler of the universe.
data.etymology: Shishpal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shishpal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shishpal carries deep cultural roots within the Hindu tradition. It is a name that represents an individual's connection to the divine and their ability to wield power and influence over their surroundings. The name's origins come from the ancient epics and scriptures, further adding to its significance and reverence within the community.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, the name Shishpal holds a profound spiritual meaning. It is a reminder of the divine spark within each of us and our inherent power to shape our reality. It is a call to tap into the wisdom and knowledge that comes from within and to use it to bring about positive change in the world around us. The name is a reminder that we are not merely passive observers in the universe, but active participants in its creation and evolution. By embracing the name Shishpal, one can cultivate a deep sense of self-awareness, inner strength, and a sense of purpose and direction in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shishpal: One who carries the wisdom of elders in their heart, always seeking knowledge and growth. A beacon of wisdom and guidance, embodying the essence of tradition and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shishpal was a king of the Vatsa dynasty in the 4th century BCE. The name Shishpal carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Shishpal ruled over the Vatsa kingdom in the Magadha region of ancient India.
